About Pachamama Inhabitant Wellness

Guided by Vision, Grounded in Practice

Our Vision

Our vision at Pachamama Inhabitant Wellness is to be the leading provider of wellness services and products in the region, offering innovative and effective solutions to promote health and well-being.

Our Approach

We take a personalized and evidence-based approach to wellness, utilizing the latest research and techniques to help our clients achieve their health goals.

Founder's Biography

Dr. Kionna Griffin brings ancestral wisdom and modern wellness practice together, guiding clients back to a sacred connection with mind, body, and Mother Earth.

About Pachamama Wellness

Our Mission

At Pachamama Inhabitant Wellness, we are dedicated to restoring harmony of mind, body, and spirit. Through holistic and nature practices with ancestral wisdom, we aim to create a sacred connection with Mother Earth.
